subject: Re: Next steps — Private/VPC licensing & environment sizing
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@finexcorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today — Private/VPC licensing and sizing

Hi Elaine — thanks again for carving out time today. Helpful call; I wanted to summarize the key items and surface a couple of follow-ups so procurement has what it needs. Please correct anything I get wrong.

Quick recap: 
- Scope: Private/VPC deployment on AWS (single-region) for FinexCorp production workflows (customer data).
- Expected model mix: 70% embeddings + retrieval, 30% LLM chat/generation for agent assist. Peak concurrent inference not fully gated yet.
- Token profile (rough): 12B tokens/month baseline, 45B tokens/month at projected scale for year 1 (embedded + calls).
- Desired economics target: you mentioned looking at budget between $9k–$18k per 1M tokens across the combined workload (including storage and infra amortization) — want to confirm if that target is per 1M input tokens or combined input+output.
- Licensing preference: desire for a fixed annual license + support model for Private (on VPC) rather than pure usage-only hosted model. Support tier target: Standard or Premium? You indicated they need 24x5 response SLAs, leaning Premium.
- Environments: 2 production clusters (primary + DR), 1 staging, 2 dev/test sandboxes.

Open items we promised to follow up on: 
1) I will send a draft pricing worksheet that maps licensing + infra amortized per 1M tokens for the environment counts you gave.
2) Monica will scope the support tiers and confirm what 24x5 Premium includes (on-call escalation, quarterly reviews, security review assistance).
3) Procurement: Elaine, can you share the target internal PO timeline and if procurement needs a fixed-term agreement (12 vs 36 months)?
4) Tom, can you confirm expected max sequence lengths and typical prompt/response ratio so we can map kernel/quantization profiles correctly.

Attached: rough MAP (attached PDF) and a template questionnaire for procurement fields we usually need. I will follow up with a preliminary quote (spreadsheet) tomorrow.

Next steps (proposed):
- Rishi: send licensing/ops worksheet and preliminary quote by EOD Mon 2026-03-09.
- Monica: send support-tier spec and SOW sketch by Tue 2026-03-10.
- Elaine/Tom: confirm PO timing and token ratio by Tue 2026-03-10.

Thanks — appreciated the clarity on drivers.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: FinexCorp-MAP-v1.pdf]
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@finexcorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Morales <tom.morales@finexcorp.com>, procurement@finexcorp.com, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 08:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today — Private/VPC licensing and sizing

Thanks Rishi — correct on most counts, a few clarifications below.

- The $9k–$18k number is a target blended cost per 1M tokens (input + output) — that is what finance is comfortable reviewing. For clarity, target is $12k/1M tokens as a midpoint we could get approval for with a firm 12-month commitment.
- Support tier: we want Premium with 24x5 response and a named technical account lead. The Premium add-on is likely required for SOC/audit coordination.
- Environments: confirm 2 prod (primary + DR), 1 staging. The dev sandboxes are team-run; procurement will initially ask for 2 but only 1 needs to be included in the license (others can be billed/allocated later). So please price for 1 dev sandbox included, with optional add-on.
- Token profile: Tom — we are doing many short embedding calls (avg 64 tokens) and chat sessions with median input 120 tokens, output 220 tokens; overall 30% generation token ratio vs embeddings. Peak concurrency: likely 40–60 concurrent LLM sessions initially.
- Term: procurement prefers 12 months to start with an option to extend to 36 months at renewal.

Procurement note: procurement@finexcorp.com — we'll need a license summary and a draft MSA or statement of work. Our standard review window is ~3 weeks.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Elaine
Director, Platform Engineering | FinexCorp
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@finexcorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Tom Morales <tom.morales@finexcorp.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today — Private/VPC licensing and sizing

Great — thanks for the clarity, Elaine and Tom. Adding a few concrete numbers so procurement can see a starting point (attached XLSX will have line-item math):

Proposed starter configuration (annual license + infra amortized):
- License (Private/VPC): fixed seat/cluster fee + usage tranche: $180k/year for base license covering 1 prod cluster + 1 staging + 1 dev sandbox.
- DR cluster add-on: $60k/year.
- Additional dev sandbox add-on: $10k/year each.
- Support Premium: $55k/year (named TAM, 24x5 SLA, quarterly business reviews, SOC assistance).

Unit economics (based on your 12B baseline / 45B projected):
- Baseline (12B tokens): blended unit cost ~ $14,500 per 1M tokens (license + infra amortization + support).
- Projected scale (45B): blended unit cost improves to ~ $10,800 per 1M tokens (volume discounts kicking in — license amortization spreads).

Action items: 
- Monica: can you confirm whether the TAM provision requires a separate SOW item (we typically roll into Premium but need to document response times).
- Sean: can you prepare an initial infra sizing note for the 40–60 concurrent sessions with token sizes Elaine provided (include GPU type recommendation + expected QPS).
- Rishi: send the XLSX quote and a draft license summary to procurement by EOD.

Attached: redwood-licensing-quote-20260309.xlsx (estimates). If the $12k/1M target is the stretch finance prefers, we can iterate term/commitment levels to approach that (higher commit -> lower blended unit cost).

Rishi

[Attachment: redwood-licensing-quote-20260309.xlsx]
From: Tom Morales <tom.morales@finexcorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@finexcorp.com>, procurement@finexcorp.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today — Private/VPC licensing and sizing

Thanks team — confirmed on our side. A couple quick notes for infra sizing and procurement: 

- We'll capture final sequence-length distribution in a short spreadsheet and drop it into the drive link you shared. Expect most calls under 512 tokens, 95th percentile ~1024.
- Procurement: please include the option for a 24-month auto-renew vs explicit renewal; we may prefer auto-renew for continuity but need the right termination clauses.
- Timeline: procurement will start review on Wed 2026-03-11, aiming to return redlines within 3 weeks.

If you need anything from IT (VPC peering, account IDs) I can get that to you by Wed EOD.

—Tom
IT Ops Manager | FinexCorp
